components.note: 临 (simplified 臨) — the old form shows a person bending over with a watching eye above a heap of goods: looking down on something, hence 'to face, to draw near'.
衤 (clothing) — marks garments and cloth, as in 衫 shirt, 裤 trousers, 裙 skirt; 衬 is the lining or shirt worn close to the body.
寸 (cùn) is only a loose sound hint for chèn.
衤 (clothing) — marks garments, as in 衬 lining, 裤 trousers, 裙 skirt, 袖 sleeve; 衫 is a shirt or gown.
彡 (shān) gives the sound exactly: 衫 shān.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand or force, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拆 tear down; 摧 is to smash or wreck.
崔 (cuī) has the same sound as 摧 cuī, and also sounds out 催 cuī (urge).
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脚 foot, 脸 face, 腿 leg, 脑 brain; 胳 is the arm (胳膊).
各 (gè) is a loose sound hint for gē; 格 gé and 路 lù share it.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body-part radical, as in 脖 neck, 腿 leg, 脑 brain; 膊 is the upper arm (胳膊).
尃 (fū) is a loose hint for bó; the same series gives 博 bó, 搏 bó and 薄 báo.
斤 (axe) — the original idea was chopping with an axe, as in 新, 斩 chop, 断 break; today 斯 is mostly a sound-borrowing syllable sī in foreign names like 俄罗斯.
异 (simplified 異) — means different or strange; its yì sound also appears in 翼 yì (wing).
疒 (illness) — the sickness radical, as in 病 illness, 痛 pain, 疼 ache, 疗 treat; 疾 is a disease, and also means swift.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talking and language, as in 说 say, 语 language, 话 speech; 词 is a word or phrase.
司 (sī) hints at the sound: 词 cí is close, and 司 also gives 饲 sì and 祠 cí.
木 (tree) — three trees make a dense forest; 林 is two trees, 森 sēn adds more.
木 (tree) — two trees side by side make a grove or forest; compare 森 with three.
辶 (movement) — marks walking, roads and motion, as in 过 pass, 进 enter, 追 chase; 迫 is to press or drive someone on.
白 (bái) is a loose hint for pò; 拍 pāi and 泊 bó share the same part.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脚 foot, 腿 leg, 脑 brain; 臂 is the arm (手臂).
辟 (pì) hints at the sound; 臂 bì is close to 避 bì and 壁 bì, which share it.
谷 (valley) — suggests an open gap, matching the sense of 'open, clear'; 豁 can also mean to exempt (豁免).
害 (hài) is only a loose sound hint for huò.
白 (bái) hints at the sound: 百 bǎi is close, and 白 also gives 拍 pāi and 伯 bó.
日 (sun) — marks light and time, as in 明 bright, 晴 clear, 时 time; the sun over 京 gives a bright scene, hence scenery.
京 (jīng) gives the sound: 景 jǐng is close, as in 影 yǐng and 惊 jīng.
氵 (water) — marks water and flowing things, as in 河, 海, 汤; 沮 originally meant to halt a flow, then to dishearten.
且 (qiě) hints at the sound: 沮 jǔ is close to 组 zǔ and 租 zū, which share it.
亡 (die, lose) — 丧 (simplified 喪) once showed crying 哭 over the dead 亡: mourning, then loss and dejection (沮丧).
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 他, 做, 作; 仿 is to imitate someone.
方 (fāng) hints at the sound: 仿 fǎng is close, as in 访 fǎng and 纺 fǎng.
宀 (roof) — a roof over fire 火 means disaster; 宀 appears in 家 home, 安 safe.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talking and language, as in 说, 语, 请; 访 is to visit and ask.
方 (fāng) hints at the sound: 访 fǎng is close, as in 仿 fǎng and 纺 fǎng.
立 (stand) — the person-standing radical, as in 站 itself and 位 position; here it carries the meaning of standing.
占 (zhàn) gives the sound exactly: 站 zhàn, also in 战 zhàn and 粘 zhān.
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks thread and weaving, as in 红 red, 线 line, 细 fine; 绩 first meant spinning, then work achieved.
责 (zé) is only a loose sound hint for jì.
灬 (fire) — the four-dot form of 火, as in 热 hot, 点 point, 煮 cook; 烈 is blazing, then intense.
列 (liè) gives the sound exactly: 烈 liè, also in 裂 liè (split).
殳 (weapon, strike) — the radical of 段 and 毁; in 殿 it has no clear meaning, so just learn 殿 as palace hall (宫殿).
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talking and teaching, as in 说, 语, 读; 课 is a lesson.
果 (guǒ) hints at the sound: 课 kè is close to 颗 kē and 棵 kē, which share it.
言 (speech) — praise is spoken; the radical of 说 and 语 in its full form.
兴 (xīng) here stands in for an older sound part: the old form 譽 had 與 (yǔ), which gave yù.
辶 (movement) — marks walking and travel, as in 过, 进, 送; 违 is to go against or part from.
韦 (wéi) gives the sound exactly: 违 wéi, also in 围 wéi and 伟 wěi.
阝 (hill, from 阜) on the left — marks mounds and steps, as in 院, 队, 附, 陆; 阶 is a stair step.
介 (jiè) hints at the sound: 阶 jiē is close to 界 jiè and 价 jià.
禾 (grain) — 香 originally combined grain with 甘 (sweet): the smell of cooked grain, in modern writing 日 stands in for 甘.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 树, 林, 桥; 槟 is the areca/betel palm (香槟 is borrowed for champagne).
宾 (bīn) gives the sound exactly: 槟 bīn, also in 滨 bīn and 缤 bīn.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 做, 住; 偷 is a person stealing.
俞 (yú) is a loose hint for tōu; 愉 yú and 输 shū share it.
大 (person) standing in the middle of a frame 冂 — the idea of the centre (中央); 央 yāng also sounds out 殃 yāng and 秧 yāng.
页 (head) — marks the head and face, as in 顶 top, 题 topic, 额 forehead; 频 pairs it with repeating motion for 'again and again'.
页 (head) — marks the head and face, as in 题, 额, 顺; 顶 is the top of the head, hence any top.
丁 (dīng) hints at the sound: 顶 dǐng is close to 订 dìng and 钉 dīng.
木 (wood) — beds were wooden frames; 木 is the radical of trees and wooden things like 桌 table and 椅 chair.
兔 — a pictograph of a rabbit: long ears on top and a short dot of a tail; compare 免 without the dot.
彡 (patterns, hairlines) — marks shape, shadow and decoration, as in 影 shadow, 彩 colour; 形 is a shape.
开 (a worn-down 幵) hints at the sound: 形 xíng sounds like 刑 and 型.
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks thread and cords, as in 线 line, 红 red; 绳 is a rope.
女 (woman) — marks female relatives and women, as in 妈 mum, 姐 sister, 姑 aunt; 姨 is mother's sister.
夷 (yí) gives the sound exactly: 姨 yí.
女 (woman) — marks women and grace, as in 妈, 姐, 好; 娜 is graceful, used in female names.
那 (nà) gives the sound: 娜 is nuó or nà, like 挪 nuó.
亻 (person) — a person falling over; marks people and their actions, as in 你, 做.
到 (dào) gives the sound: 倒 is dǎo (fall) or dào (upside down).
雨 (rain) — marks weather and damp, as in 雪 snow, 雷 thunder, 雾 fog; 霉 is mould that grows in damp weather.
每 (měi) hints at the sound: 霉 méi is close, and 梅 méi shares 每.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 胸 is the chest.
匈 (xiōng) gives the sound exactly: 胸 xiōng.
心 (heart) — loyalty is of the heart, as in 想 think, 爱 love, 思; 心 sits at the bottom.
中 (zhōng) gives the sound exactly: 忠 zhōng, also in 钟 zhōng.
女 (woman) — marks women and girls, as in 妈, 姐, 好; 妞 is a girl.
丑 (chǒu) is only a loose sound hint for niū.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 树, 林, 桥; 橄 is the olive tree (橄榄).
敢 (gǎn) gives the sound exactly: 橄 gǎn.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 树, 林, 桥; 榄 is the olive tree (橄榄).
览 (lǎn) gives the sound exactly: 榄 lǎn, also in 揽 lǎn and 缆 lǎn.
广 (building) — marks halls and structures, as in 店 shop, 库 store, 座 seat; 廊 is a corridor.
郎 (láng) gives the sound exactly: 廊 láng, also in 狼 láng.
